verifications.claim: PlayStation Network is recovering from a major, widespread outage as of March 21-22, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'widespread outage on Saturday evening'; R3: 'PSN Servers outage affected the Gaming & Social services worldwide, starting from the 21st of March'; R5: 'outage graphs continue to fall... recovery is nearly complete' on March 21-22, 2026
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm a major outage on March 21-22, 2026, with status updates showing recovery in progress despite some lingering issues.

verifications.claim: Many PlayStation Network services are back online as of March 21-22, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'status page has since been updated to indicate that all services are back online'; R3: 'All services online'; R4: 'All services are up and running'; R5: 'Status page now says all services are online'
verifications.reasoning: Status pages and articles directly state services are back online as of the dates.

verifications.claim: Some users still experience issues with games and social features on PlayStation Network as of March 21-22, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'some users continue to experience issues with Gaming & Social features'; R3: 'Some users are now able to connect... but with side issues like friends list'; R5: 'Loads of people were still locked out from playing games online'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly note ongoing user issues with games and social features post-outage.

verifications.claim: Sony's official status page initially reported issues with "Gaming & Social" services.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'affected category was listed specifically as "Gaming & Social"'; R3: 'affected the Gaming & Social services'; R5: 'services in question were "Gaming & Social"'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly quote or confirm status page initial report on Gaming & Social issues.

verifications.claim: Most PlayStation Network services are now reported as functional.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'all services are back online'; R3: 'PlayStation Network Status at status.playstation.com now reads "All services online"'; R4: 'All services are up and running'; R5: 'Status page now says all services are online'
verifications.reasoning: Official status page and articles confirm most/all services functional currently.

verifications.claim: A major, global outage occurred on PlayStation Network.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: peak over 14,000 reports; R2: 'widespread outage... across multiple continents'; R3: 'worldwide... peak on Downdetector was 50,000+ reports'; R5: significant Downdetector spikes
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe outage as widespread/global with high report peaks.

verifications.claim: The PlayStation Network outage caused issues with logging in on PS4 and PS5.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'server connection & login reports... sign in errors'; R2: 'locked out of games, apps, and online features... PS4 and PS5'; R3: 'increases in sign in errors'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm login and connection issues on PS4/PS5 during outage.

verifications.claim: The PlayStation Network outage caused issues with accessing online games on PS4 and PS5.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'difficulty launching games... unable to play... Call of Duty, Battlefield'; R2: 'difficulty launching games, apps... on both PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4'; R5: 'locked out from playing games online'
verifications.reasoning: Direct mentions of issues launching/playing online games on PS4/PS5.

verifications.claim: The PlayStation Network outage caused issues with using social features on PS4 and PS5.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: services hit include “Challenges, Game Help, Game Streaming, Tournaments, Trophies”; R2: '"Gaming & Social" — the backbone of online play on both PS5 and PS4'; R3: 'side issues like friends list'
verifications.reasoning: Gaming & Social category and specific social features like friends list affected on PS4/PS5.

verifications.claim: Reports from users indicate the PlayStation Network situation is settling down.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'sharp fall in the number of people facing issues'; R3: 'trends on Downdetector indicate a sharp decline'; R5: 'things now seem to be fully settling down... outage graphs continue to fall'
verifications.reasoning: User reports and Downdetector data show situation improving/settling.

verifications.claim: Reports from users indicate most PlayStation Network services are returning to normal.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'service is resuming slowly... Most consoles can be fixed'; R5: 'we're getting back online properly... number of you viewing this report live has dropped dramatically'
verifications.reasoning: User comments and live updates indicate services returning to normal for most.
